item.product: Branch Manager, Dietary Supplement for Men 18+, packaged in single capsule blister card, 24 individual blister cards per retail box;
item.summary: FDA laboratory analysis confirmed that the product contains yohimbine that is not declared on the product labels. Product details: Branch Manager, Dietary Supplement for Men 18+, packaged in single capsule blister card, 24 individual blister cards per retail box; UPC 672713228585. Labeled serving size: one capsule; proprietary blend 1600 mg; directions state one capsule 20 minutes before ...
item.affectedPeople: The products were sold to 9 consignees by internet sales through SUPPLX.com to Florida, Georgia, New York, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin. No wholesale, distributor, or retail-store distribution occurred during the recall period.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
